description: This file defines the PrivilegedRequest class within the Thunder::Core namespace, including nested classes Descriptor and Connection. It provides mechanisms for managing privileged file descriptors over domain sockets, including opening, requesting, offering, and handling socket communication, with support for UNIX domain sockets and descriptor passing.

classes.name: PrivilegedRequest
classes.description: Main class managing privileged file descriptor requests and offers, including nested Descriptor and Connection classes.

classes.name: Descriptor
classes.description: Represents a file descriptor, managing duplication and cleanup of system descriptors.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Handles UNIX domain socket communication, including opening, closing, reading, and writing descriptor messages, with support for socket events and callbacks.

methods.name: PrivilegedRequest
methods.description: Constructor for PrivilegedRequest, optionally accepting a callback.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a privileged request channel with the specified identifier.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Requests descriptors from a privileged request.

methods.name: Offer
methods.description: Offers descriptors in response to a privileged request.
